wo-jpfa-JR5269.d:
PT Ciomas Adisatwa

Job Summary

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a dedicated PPL (Petugas Penyuluh Lapangan / Field Extension Officer) Broiler for the Sengkang Commercial Poultry Division (CPD). The successful candidate will act as a technical advisor and partner to our contract broiler farmers, ensuring optimal farm management, flock health, and production efficiency to meet the company's rigorous quality standards.

Job Responsibilities

* Provide technical guidance and counseling to contract farmers regarding broiler farm management, biosecurity, and feeding programs.
* Monitor and evaluate the daily growth, health, and mortality rates of the broiler flocks.
* Assist farmers in troubleshooting disease outbreaks and implementing effective biosecurity measures.
* Coordinate the distribution of production inputs (day-old chicks, feed, and medicines) and manage the harvesting process.
* Maintain accurate records of farm performance and prepare regular reports for the branch management.

Job Qualifications

* Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree (S1) or Diploma (D3) in Animal Husbandry (Peternakan) or Veterinary Medicine (Kedokteran Hewan).
* Proven experience in broiler farm management or as a Field Extension Officer (PPL) is highly preferred; fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* Deep knowledge of poultry health, biosecurity, and modern broiler farming systems.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills to effectively collaborate with local farmers.
* Possession of a valid driver’s license (SIM C) and willingness to be hands-on in the field and mobile across the Sengkang area.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
